body:
Looks correct. I haven't tested the code but I see the same mismatch.

Looking into it, the bug can only manifest when `DEBUG_ENABLED` is not defined, because otherwise, `pre_pad` in `alloc_static` will always be true (and it is assumed to be false in `memdelete`, but true in `memdelete_arr`). Pair that with this code only running for when call stack tracking is enabled, and it's probably why nobody else ran into this problem yet.

Note: I think this is a regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76582
